source.note: Audits localized primary portrait sources and their generated display derivatives. Original images are not modified.

processingGuidance.defaultMode: cover crop for normal portrait ratios
processingGuidance.atypicalMode: neutral matte fit for very wide or very tall source images
processingGuidance.colorPolicy: No color, tone, smoothing, face retouching, or generative alteration is applied by the portrait preparation script.
processingGuidance.manualReview: Low-resolution, wide, tall, missing, and rights-pending records should be reviewed before permanent installation.
